name: 陳岡伯
objective: n the second semester, apart from further refining students' writing skills (in the modes of classification and extended definition), the course will also introduce key theoretical approaches in literary and cultural studies to help students establish their arguments and methodologies of their senior projects. Students will read excerpts from original theoretical texts and critical essays that involve theoretical frameworks and write a full research paper at the end of the semester.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to the course and reviewing the common errors/defects in the 2 essays written in last semester  
Week 2-3: Classification essay: exercise  
Week 3-4: Extended definition: exercise
Week 5-6: Introduction to theories, methods of critical reading
Week 7: Introduction to psychoanalysis
Week 8: Exercise: psychoanalytical readings of "The Black Cat"
Week 9: Exercise: psychoanalytical readings of "The Garden of Love"
Week 10: Gender studies: introduction to feminism
Week 11: Film viewing: Thelma & Louise
Week 12: Exercise: feminist readings of Thelma & Louise
Week 13: Gender studies: introduction to queer theory
Week 14: Film viewing: The Birdcage 
Week 15: Exercise: queer readings of The Birdcage
Week 16: Introduction to postcolonial studies: Orientalism, the subaltern 
Week 17: Film viewing: M. Butterfly
Week 18: Exercise: postcolonial readings of M. Butterfly
materials:
All materials will be provided by the instructor.
